reference: Sulfidic argillite and polymetallic massive sulfide (title)

description.lithology: Basalt, dark grey to black, aphanitic to fine-grained, massive to brecciated with spotted variolitic to amygdaloidal texture in lower row and irregular vein-breccia fabric in upper right
description.alteration: moderate chloritic with carbonate veining, locally weak oxidized

anomalies.explanation: Irregular light grey to pinkish vein-breccia network in upper right core should be checked for vein composition and breccia origin.
Sharp irregular contact in lower row between dark spotted basalt and underlying pale green fractured breccia should be checked as possible flow contact or breccia zone.
